# Hi, I'm Jiru 👋🏻

I am a computational geneticist and data scientist with a research background in statistical genetics, genomics, multi-omics integration, and a growing interest in biomedical AI and reproducible workflows.

I am currently based in Hamburg, Germany, and exploring new research and industry opportunities in computational biology, bioinformatics, and data science.

I was previously a Senior Research Fellow in the [Bahlo Lab][Bahlo] within the [Molecular Sciences Division][GGR] at the [Walter and Eliza Hall Institute of Medical Research][WEHI]. I completed my PhD in the [Bahlo Lab][Bahlo] at the University of Melbourne, Australia.

Check out my [projects](/projects) and [publications](/publications) to find out more about me and my work!

:::
